text: On February 23, 2016, the City received a Zoning By-law Amendment application for 22 Balliol Street to permit a 38 storey (119.25 metre not including mechanical penthouse) mixed-use (retail and residential) rental building containing 425 dwelling units. The applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its application for the Zoning By-law Amendment (the "Appeal") to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal, now the Ontario Land Tribunal, on October 26, 2017. At its meeting of January 30 and 31, 2019, City Council directed the City Solicitor, along with appropriate staff, to oppose the application at the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal. A twelve day hearing was originally scheduled to commence at the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal on June 15, 2020.
